name: typing-animation
title: Typing Animation
description: A line of bold text that types itself out one character at a time with a small blinking cursor, pauses, deletes, and moves on to the next phrase in a loop.
use: A hero or heading should cycle through a few short phrases with a typewriter feel.
avoid: Important copy; the text is repeatedly deleted and hard to catch while typing.
a11y: The changing text has no live region, so screen readers may not announce it, and reduced-motion is never checked. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Large, heavy white letters sit on a black field, ending in a thin vertical bar cursor. A half-typed line leaves a lot of empty space to its right, and the text starts from the left.
behaves: Characters appear one after another at a steady pace with the cursor blinking at the end, then the line is erased the same way and the next phrase begins. It replays forever.
customise: Pass words as an array or a single string child, and tune duration, typeSpeed, deleteSpeed, delay, pauseDelay, loop, cursorStyle and cursor visibility; the tag is chosen with as.
weight: light: A chain of timeouts updates a short string; there is no continuous frame loop.
